Context: Relaxation of standard of suitability

## Relaxation of standard of suitability  
- If sufficient number of candidates with benchmark disabilities candidates are not available, candidates belonging to this category may be selected on relaxed standard to fill up the remaining vacancies reserved for them provided they are mot found unfit for such post or posts. However, this provision shall not he used to allow any relaxation in the eligibility criteria laid down for the
- (i) issuance of certificate of disability.
